# Observed on BigQuery via bqanswers, promoted from unverified/foreign_key_alter.txt.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS bqa_fk_alter_missing;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_alter_missing.child (a INT64);
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_missing.child DROP CONSTRAINT absent
=> error contains: Not found: Constraint absent

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS bqa_fk_alter_duplicate;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_alter_duplicate.parent (id INT64 PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_alter_duplicate.child (a INT64);
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_duplicate.child ADD CONSTRAINT fk FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES bqa_fk_alter_duplicate.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED;
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_duplicate.child ADD CONSTRAINT fk FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES bqa_fk_alter_duplicate.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED
=> error contains: Already Exists: Constraint fk

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS bqa_fk_alter_case;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_alter_case.parent (id INT64 PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_alter_case.child (a INT64);
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_case.child ADD CONSTRAINT MixedCase FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES bqa_fk_alter_case.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED;
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_case.child DROP CONSTRAINT mixedcase;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bqa_fk_alter_case.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE table_name = 'child'
=> "0"

# Generated names when adding unnamed keys to a table that already has one.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS bqa_fk_alter_generated;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated.parent (id INT64 PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated.child (a INT64, b INT64);
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated.child ADD FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES bqa_fk_alter_generated.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED;
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated.child ADD FOREIGN KEY (b) REFERENCES bqa_fk_alter_generated.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED;
SELECT STRING_AGG(constraint_name, ', ' ORDER BY constraint_name) FROM bqa_fk_alter_generated.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE table_name = 'child'
=> "child.fk$1, child.fk$2"

# Removing an earlier generated name does not cause that name to be reused.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS bqa_fk_alter_generated_gap;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_gap.parent (id INT64 PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_gap.child (a INT64, b INT64);
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_gap.child ADD FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES bqa_fk_alter_generated_gap.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED;
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_gap.child ADD FOREIGN KEY (b) REFERENCES bqa_fk_alter_generated_gap.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED;
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_gap.child DROP CONSTRAINT `fk$1`;
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_gap.child ADD FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES bqa_fk_alter_generated_gap.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED;
SELECT STRING_AGG(constraint_name, ', ' ORDER BY constraint_name) FROM bqa_fk_alter_generated_gap.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE table_name = 'child'
=> "child.fk$2, child.fk$3"

# Removing the highest generated name allows that name to be reused.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS bqa_fk_alter_generated_last;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_last.parent (id INT64 PRIMARY KEY NOT ENFORCED);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_last.child (a INT64, b INT64);
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_last.child ADD FOREIGN KEY (a) REFERENCES bqa_fk_alter_generated_last.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED;
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_last.child ADD FOREIGN KEY (b) REFERENCES bqa_fk_alter_generated_last.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED;
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_last.child DROP CONSTRAINT `fk$2`;
ALTER TABLE bqa_fk_alter_generated_last.child ADD FOREIGN KEY (b) REFERENCES bqa_fk_alter_generated_last.parent(id) NOT ENFORCED;
SELECT STRING_AGG(constraint_name, ', ' ORDER BY constraint_name) FROM bqa_fk_alter_generated_last.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE table_name = 'child'
=> "child.fk$1, child.fk$2"
